div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p: VALIDITY RULE · a call stays DESIRED only while its content key is in the ACTIVE goal's desired keys · keys are computed from current slot values + results of DESIRED upstream calls · a SUPERSEDED call is never used again, even if its key returns · so a correction supersedes exactly the work that read the changed value, and unrelated work (c2) keeps running
